# Compile failure from LLM budget exhaustion

When the semantic extraction raises LLMBudgetExceeded, the code translates this into a CompileError and the compile run fails (resumable). This creates a risk that external LLM rate/quota limits can stop progress until budget is restored.

**Anchored to:**

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._compile_one`
- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run._extract_semantic`

## Affects

- [knowledge_compiler.extractors.llm_extractor](../component/knowledge-compiler-extractors-llm-extractor.md)
- [knowledge_compiler.llm.provider](../component/knowledge-compiler-llm-provider.md)
